{{Quote|The traitor in my house is my own beastmaster. He plots against me and thinks I do not know.|[[Suudaa Nem'ro]]|<ref name="TOR:HC" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was killed by the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now I kill you and Nem'ro give me big reward.|The beast master, speaking to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR:HC" />}}
Nem'ro had sent the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] to kill the beast master, expressing that he was a traitor that needed to be dealt with; however, when the hunter arrived at the beast pit, the beast master revealed that he knew the hunter was coming, and had prepared his beasts to attack. This ambush of the hunter in the beast pit of [[Nem'ro's Palace]] was revealed to be part of Nem'ro's test to earn his sponsorship in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. It was also used as a spectacle of entertainment for Nem'ro and the palace's visitors. The beast master was killed in the ensuing battle after his beasts, including [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]], [[Vrblther/Legends|vrblthers]] and [[Akk wolf|akk wolves]] as well as [[Boneshatter|Boneshatter the Rampager]], [[Clawbane|Clawbane the Indomitable]] and [[Fleshripper|Fleshripper the Unkillable]], failed to kill the hunter.<ref name="TOR:HC" />
